# Grow Orbit

We run the systems that scale Amazon brands. 

## Full-Service Amazon FBA Partner
- **Full-Service FBA Management:** Complete account delegation. We handle PPC, SEO, logistics, operations, and creative design under a performance-based pricing model (% of growth).

## Core Service Blueprints

- **Amazon PPC & DSP Advertising:** 
  - *PPC management:* 4-tier campaign structure, bid optimization, and ACoS control.
  - *Amazon DSP:* Programmatic display ads and audience retargeting.
- **Listing Optimization & SEO Copywriting:** A9-optimized copy, keyword indexing, and listing health audits.
- **Visual Engineering & A+ Creative:** CTR-tested main images, Premium A+ Content (EBC) layouts, Brand Stories, and storefront designs.
- **Product Sourcing & Vetting:** Direct factory sourcing, supplier negotiations, quality control, and logistics logistics coordination.
- **Brand Launch & Honeymoon Strategy:** Launch protocols, initial PPC setup, and ranking systems to hit Page 1 quickly.
- **Trademark & Brand Protection:** Fast IP filing, listing security, hijacker removal, and brand registry enforcement.
- **Ongoing Operations & Support:** Case resolution, FBA shipping management, catalog auditing, and daily health monitoring.
- **Shopify & DTC Web Development:** Building high-conversion custom storefronts and landing pages to scale off-Amazon.
- **Coaching & Consultation:** 1-on-1 strategic audits and operational blueprints for 6 and 7-figure brands.

## Free Amazon Tools & Calculators

- **Profit Calculator:** Net margin and ROI estimator.
- **Storage Fee Calculator:** FBA monthly storage fee simulator.
- **Quick Estimator:** Instant referral and fulfillment fee estimation.
- **FBA Fee Calculator:** Detailed comparison of Amazon fees vs FBM rates.
- **FBA vs FBM vs 3PL:** Multi-channel logistics cost comparison.
